program:
PARAMS = {
    "Lr":     (0.5, 0.15, 1.2),        # ring inverter L (sets free-running f)
    "I_foot": (30e-6, 8e-6, 80e-6),    # footer current at vctrl = mid (power limiter / tuning)
    "Lf":     (0.5, 0.15, 2.0),        # footer L
    "Wn":     (0.42, 0.42, 1.2),       # ring NMOS W
    "rp":     (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),         # ring PMOS/NMOS width ratio
    "Wb1":    (0.42, 0.42, 1.5),       # buffer stage-1 NMOS W (PMOS = 2x)
    "Wb2":    (0.6, 0.42, 3.0),        # buffer stage-2 NMOS W (PMOS = 2x)
    "Cff":    (5e-15, 1e-15, 30e-15),  # feed-forward cap b1 -> vout (rail overshoot)
    "Cvs":    (100e-15, 20e-15, 400e-15),  # virtual-ground decoupling
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vlo, vhi = spec.get("vctrl_range", [0.7, 1.4])
    vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi)
    VDD = 1.8
    CL = spec.get("cl", 20e-15)
    N = 5
    L0 = 0.15
    Lr = p["Lr"]
    Wn = p["Wn"]
    Wp = p["rp"] * Wn

    # footer NMOS: gate = vctrl, sized for I_foot at vmid with small vds (~0.25 V)
    Lf = p["Lf"]
    idw = lut.op("n", 1.0, Lf, vmid, 0.25)["Id"]
    Wf = max(0.42, p["I_foot"] / max(idw, 1e-15))
    If_of = lambda v: max(0.05e-6, lut.op("n", Wf, Lf, v, 0.25)["Id"])

    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    n.M("MF", "vs", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wf, Lf)
    n.C("CVS", "vs", "vss", p["Cvs"])

    nodes = [f"r{i}" for i in range(N)]
    for i in range(N):
        a = nodes[i]
        y = nodes[(i + 1) % N]
        n.M(f"MP{i}", y, a, "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lr)
        n.M(f"MN{i}", y, a, "vs", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Lr)

    n.M("MB1P", "b1", "r0", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * p["Wb1"], L0)
    n.M("MB1N", "b1", "r0", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wb1"], L0)
    n.M("MB2P", "vout", "b1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * p["Wb2"], L0)
    n.M("MB2N", "vout", "b1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wb2"], L0)
    n.C("CFF", "b1", "vout", p["Cff"])

    # ---- first-order model ----
    cg = lambda d, W, L: lut.op(d, W, L, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"]
    Cg_inv = cg("n", Wn, Lr) + cg("p", Wp, Lr)
    Cnode = 1.4 * Cg_inv + 1.0e-15
    Cb1 = cg("n", p["Wb1"], L0) + cg("p", 2 * p["Wb1"], L0)
    Cavg = Cnode + Cb1 / N
    Vsw = 1.6
    In = lut.op("n", Wn, Lr, Vsw, Vsw / 2)["Id"]
    Ip = lut.op("p", Wp, Lr, Vsw, Vsw / 2)["Id"]
    Iav = 0.5 * (In + Ip)
    td = 0.5 * Cavg * Vsw / max(Iav, 1e-12)
    f_free = 1.0 / (2 * N * td)

    def f_of(v):
        If = If_of(v)
        f_lim = If / (1.3 * N * Cavg * Vsw)
        return min(f_free, f_lim)

    f_lo, f_md, f_hi = f_of(vlo), f_of(vmid), f_of(vhi)
    I_ring = min(If_of(vmid), 1.3 * N * Cavg * Vsw * f_md)
    Cb2 = cg("n", p["Wb2"], L0) + cg("p", 2 * p["Wb2"], L0)
    Csw_buf = Cb1 + Cb2 + 2 * p["Cff"] + CL
    power = VDD * I_ring + 1.4 * Csw_buf * VDD**2 * f_md

    Cout = CL + p["Cff"] + 0.5 * Cb2
    swing = VDD + 0.3 * VDD * p["Cff"] / Cout

    return n, {"f_lo": f_lo, "f_mid": f_md, "f_hi": f_hi,
               "fmin": f_lo, "fmax": f_hi,
               "tuning_ratio": f_hi / max(f_lo, 1.0),
               "kvco": (f_hi - f_lo) / (vhi - vlo),
               "swing": swing, "power": power}
